test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2022: Official Paper (Held On: 09 March, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: The Chief Minister of which state launched "Football for All" in the state to take the culture of football to the grassroots?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Odisha**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Odisha CM **Naveen Patnaik** on **10th Oct 2022** launched ‘**Football for All**’ in the state to take the culture of football to the grassroots.
 
• It has been initiated by FIFA in Odisha in partnership with the** Kalinga Institute of Industrial Technology** & **Kalinga Institute of Social Sciences**.
 
• This is the first such programme of FIFA in India that aims at promoting football among **school children**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The organization Utkal Sammilani was formed in 1903 to demand the unification of Odia-speaking regions into one state.
 
• The Province of Bihar and Orissa was formed on 1 April 1912.
 
• Bihar and Orissa were subdivided into separate provinces on 1 April 1936.
 
• The new Province of Orissa was created on a linguistic basis during the British rule in India, with Sir John Austen Hubback as the first governor.
 
• On 15 August 1947, the agreement to join Orissa was signed by 27 princely States.
